title: b7z9.24.4: C: multi-root ztest consuming ccp16-desync.json multi_root vectors
description: Create lichen/tests/multi_root/ ztest suite exercising the C multi-root selection and version-change SFN reset against ccp16-desync.json multi_root_version_conflict_desync vector and any additional multi-root vectors. Must match Python/Rust behavior.
close_reason: Covered by two landed suites (worker1): multi-root selection is unit-pinned by lichen/tests/tdma_root_select (criteria order, 2:1 weighting, IID tiebreak, signature fail-closed filter, bead b7z9.24.2), and the version-change SFN-reset half of multi_root_version_conflict_desync is driven against the actual vector file by lichen/tests/desync_fsm (case_multi_root_version_conflict_desync, bead b7z9.12.3 slice). A third dedicated ztest would duplicate both.
